# Unified Delivery Framework (UDF)

> UDF is a modular, technology-agnostic framework for evidence-based delivery by human, technical, and hybrid actors. It covers governance, assurance, delegation, agentic systems, sovereignty, interoperability, and continuous learning.

## Usage contract

- Determine whether the request is analysis, assessment, planning, application, validation, gate review, or audit.
- Do not modify a project when only analysis or assessment was requested.
- Derive controls from context and evidence; do not make optional technologies mandatory.
- Keep the accountable human or organization explicit when delegating to agents.
- Cite the framework version and the specific source used for material recommendations.
